assessment: Only one executable statement changed: the point-search handler clears the exact owned cutoff traceback after the identity guard and original cutoff trace event. All other function/class ASTs are identical; VERSION also changed. Foreign/Root faults escape before cleanup. The original restoration checks and evidence fields remain.

All 3 workers returned complete saved records. Observed across every job: 112 point placements and 12 audits. Qualified within 3 admitted whole jobs: 112 placements and 12 audits. Raw observations from rejected jobs remain diagnostic only.

The historical table compares one cold development run per case/version. Timed search prefixes and allocation or collection behavior may differ. Neither the peaks nor the changed attempt counts establish phase-memory attribution, statistical speedup or a universal bound.

Certified markings remove twelve initial candidate incidences in each admitted case. The 144 returned word-reference controls belong to admitted cases; controls in rejected jobs remain separately labeled observations. These shallow first-row exclusions are not multiscale proof abstractions.

The admitted jobs contain 9 returned searches and 9 skipped cluster arms. Full Native ground-registry unknowns still prevent a complete six-arm comparison. No reinforcement-learning policy was trained.

Clearing the traceback removes one reference path to unwound recursive frames. It does not remove graph copies during active recursion, clear arbitrary cause/context references, guarantee collection or RSS return, or undo an earlier high-water mark. No phase-specific allocation profile was collected.

The next scientific obstacle is the cluster prerequisite. An ordering hint and a newly registered inference block have different trust requirements. Any admission change needs a separately declared, reviewed experiment with complete primitive fallback and final proof checking; old unknowns and skipped arms remain unchanged.

The full program remains practical boundary tiling, learned hierarchical receptor and lemma inventories, genuine learned proposals, and automated arithmetic and symbolic Hilbert-geometry proof discovery with honest conventional benchmarks. Physical universal Wang qualification and Turtle/Penrose plane constructions remain unfinished.
